The '''Tallimarians'''<ref name="TJOJ">''[[The Jaws of Jakku]]''</ref> were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]. The aristocrat [[Centada Ressad]]<ref name="HNSNSN" /> from the [[Ressad Dynasty]] from [[Tallimar Prime]] and the [[scavenger]] [[Velorie Sarcon]] on the planet [[Jakku]] were members of the species.<ref name="TJOJ" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their elongated craniums.<ref name="TLJ" />

==Species in the galaxy==
Members of the species called [[Tallimar Prime]] their home.<ref name="TJOJ" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date Note">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']] in [[34 ABY]]. ''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'' takes place immediately after the end of ''The Force Awakens''.</ref> a member of this species, [[Centada Ressad]], was present at [[Canto Casino and Racetrack]] on the [[planet]] [[Cantonica]].<ref name="TLJ" /> Around that same time,<ref name="Date Audiobook">The events of ''The Jaws of Jakku'' take place between the events of {{Film|VIII}} and {{Film|IX}}, which corresponds to between [[34 ABY]] and [[35 ABY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> another member of this species, [[Velorie Sarcon]] worked as a [[scavenger]] on the [[desert]] planet [[Jakku]] and falsely pretended to be a niece of Centada Ressad.<ref name="TJOJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Centada-Ressad-Concept.jpg|thumb|right|200px|King 35 by Ivan Manzella]]
The species made their onscreen debut in the [[2017]] film {{Film|VIII}}, directed by [[Rian Johnson]].<ref name="TLJ" /> They were originally designed by creature concept designer and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]],<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella - Creature & Character Designs|archivedate=20240604150100}}</ref> and were referred to by the production code "King 35."<ref name="art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Last Jedi]]''</ref> According to the Keeper of the Holocron, [[Leland Chee]], as of [[April 1]], [[2025]], this species still did not have a name within the official [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Unnamed Aliens">{{WookDiscord|discordname=.holocronkeeper|name=Leland Chee|date=2025-04-01|messagelink=https://discord.com/channels/397848917036761090/492457166771322881/1356720840036847656|archivefile=File:Holocron-Keeper-Unnamed-Species-TLJ.png}}</ref> They were first identified as the Tallimarians in the [[Star Wars Adventures: Audible Originals|Audible-exclusive]] audiobook ''[[The Jaws of Jakku]]'', written by [[Cavan Scott]],<ref name="TJOJ" /> that was released on [[October 9]] later that same year<ref name="Audible">{{Audible|domain=co.uk|url=pd/Star-Wars-The-Jaws-of-Jakku-Audiobook/B0DDYZJ3DV|text=Star Wars: The Jaws of Jakku}}</ref> and identified Centada Ressad and Velorie Sarcon as members of the species. Although, due to being an audio exclusive,<ref name="TJOJ" /> the actual spelling of the species name has not yet been confirmed.
